title: RT-PCR for Norovirus Detection
author: Hengyun Guan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q3sdyne
materials: MagNA Pure LC Total Nucleic Acid Isolation
Extract total RNA of specimens with the MagNA Pure LC Total Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit (Roche, Mannheim, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Extract total RNA of specimens with the MagNA Pure LC Total Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit (Roche, Mannheim, Germany) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RT-PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the RT-PCR reaction using SuperScript III One-Step RT-PCR with Platinum Taq (Life Technologies Catalog #: 12574026) and the specified primers.

substeps.instruction: Use primers G1-SKF/G1-SKR for GI detection
Use primers COG2F/G2SKR for GII detection

steps.title: Perform Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the amplification according to the following thermal cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Cycling (40 cycles): 95℃ for 30 s, 50℃ for 30 s, and 72℃ for 30 s

steps.title: Validate Amplicon Size and Genotype
steps.instruction: Verify the resulting amplicons and sequence the products to validate the Norovirus (NoV) genotype.

substeps.instruction: Confirm GI amplicon size is 330 bp
Confirm GII amplicon size is 387 bp
